title: Five principles guiding every project
intro: A humble, rigorous methodology rooted in local realities.
hint: Scroll to go through the 5 principles · WAHHF Foundation

items.title: Listening
items.desc: Start from the needs expressed by young people, mothers and people on the ground, without imposing a preconceived model.
items.label: Youth · Mothers · Field

items.title: Co-construction
items.desc: Build every action with local teachers, health workers and associations, for a shared impact.
items.label: Teachers · Health workers · Associations

items.title: Sustainability
items.desc: Favour passing on lasting skills (languages, trades, ecology) over handouts.
items.label: Languages · Trades · Ecology

items.title: Transparency
items.desc: Account for how the funds committed are used.
items.label: Use of funds

items.title: Partnerships
items.desc: Draw on the skills of the IROKO Group and of Cameroonian and European institutions.
items.label: IROKO · Cameroon · Europe
